c1-25-01.title: Communicative Challenge: A Duty of the State
c1-25-01.scenario: You have read an article about the Fundamental Law. Károly asks what the state must do for its citizens.
c1-25-01.prompt: Tell Károly one thing the state must do.
c1-25-01.target: Az állam köteles védeni az alapjogokat.
c1-25-01.english: The state is obliged to protect fundamental rights.
c1-25-01.canDo: I can say what the state or a rule obliges with *köteles* and *kötelezettségként*.

c1-25-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A Decree and a Statute
c1-25-02.scenario: You have read about a decree that conflicts with a statute. Károly asks what happens to such a decree.
c1-25-02.prompt: Tell Károly what the court does with the decree.
c1-25-02.target: A bíróság megsemmisíti a törvénnyel ütköző rendeletet.
c1-25-02.english: The court annuls the decree that conflicts with the statute.
c1-25-02.canDo: I can say which norm ranks above another (*jogforrási hierarchia*, *alkotmányi szupremácia*, *megsemmisítés*).

c1-25-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Parliament and Government
c1-25-03.scenario: Károly asks whether the government can decide on a new tax alone. You have read what each power does.
c1-25-03.prompt: Tell Károly what parliament does and what the government does.
c1-25-03.target: A parlament törvényt alkot, a kormány viszont végrehajtja azt.
c1-25-03.english: Parliament makes the law; the government, however, carries it out.
c1-25-03.canDo: I can say what parliament may decide and what the government may decide (*kizárólagos tárgykör*, *végrehajtó hatalom*, *rendeletalkotási jog*).

c1-25-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Why Divide Power
c1-25-04.scenario: Károly asks why the powers of the state are separated.
c1-25-04.prompt: Tell Károly why power is divided.
c1-25-04.target: A hatalomkoncentráció megakadályozása végett osztják meg a hatalmat.
c1-25-04.english: Power is divided in order to prevent the concentration of power.
c1-25-04.canDo: I can explain what checks and balances are (*fékek és ellensúlyok*, *hatalommegosztás*, *bírói függetlenség*).

c1-25-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Decree and the Fundamental Law
c1-25-05.scenario: Károly asks whether a new decree meets the Fundamental Law. You have read that it meets it only in part.
c1-25-05.prompt: Tell Károly how far the decree meets the Fundamental Law.
cues: Say how far it meets the Fundamental Law
c1-25-05.target: A rendelet csak részben felel meg az Alaptörvénynek.
c1-25-05.english: The decree meets the Fundamental Law only in part.
c1-25-05.canDo: I can grade a judgement with a degree adverb (*maradéktalanul*, *részben*, *számottevően*).

c1-25-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: How the Powers Are Kept Apart
c1-25-consolidation.scenario: Károly asks you to explain in two sentences how the powers of the state are kept apart.
c1-25-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly what parliament and the government do, and why power is divided.
c1-25-consolidation.target: Míg a parlament törvényt alkot, addig a kormány végrehajtja azt. A hatalmat a hatalomkoncentráció megakadályozása végett osztják meg.
c1-25-consolidation.english: While parliament makes the law, the government carries it out. Power is divided in order to prevent the concentration of power.
c1-25-consolidation.canDo: I can use the words for norms, the powers of the state and checks and balances.
